query:
UPDATE club_invites
         SET revoked_at = CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NULL
                                    AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
                                    AND (max_uses IS NULL OR use_count < max_uses)
                               THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE revoked_at END
         WHERE id = $1 AND invitee_id = $2
         RETURNING id
